# Estuardo Mazariegos for Los Angeles City Council District 9

> Estuardo Mazariegos is a community organizer running for Los Angeles City Council District 9 in the general election on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. He is endorsed by United Teachers Los Angeles and U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders, and he refuses all corporate campaign contributions. This site is an independent expenditure, not authorized by or coordinated with a City candidate or a committee controlled by a candidate.

## About Estuardo Mazariegos

- Came to Los Angeles as a child, fleeing political violence.
- Father and community organizer who has spent 20 years fighting for families in South Central Los Angeles.
- Helped lead the fights for L.A.'s Tenant Anti-Harassment Ordinance and Resident Protection Ordinance, and helped pass Measure ULA, which funds affordable housing and homelessness programs. (Sources: https://ourrevolution.com/estuardo-mazariegos-for-la-city-council-d-9/ ; https://www.progressivevotersguide.com/california/2026/primary/estuardo-mazariegos)
- Refuses all corporate campaign contributions; the only corporate-free candidate in this election.
- Endorsed by United Teachers Los Angeles and U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders (https://laist.com/news/politics/voter-guides/2026-general-election-la-city-council-district-9), the National Union of Healthcare Workers, SEIU Locals 1000 and 2015, SEIU-USWW (https://wavepublication.com/9th-district-black-residents-will-be-heard-candidates-say/), and the Los Angeles League of Conservation Voters (https://lalcv.org/lalcv-endorses-estuardo-mazariegos-for-los-angeles-city-council-district-9/).

## Priorities

- Lower the cost of living for working families, from rent to groceries: keep rents in check, protect homeowners from foreclosure and rising costs, bring good-paying jobs close to home.
- Fix streets, sidewalks, and streetlights.
- End the homelessness crisis with housing and services.
- A council office that delivers services for the neighborhood.

## The election

- Candidates on the ballot: Estuardo Mazariegos and Jose Ugarte. The seat is open.
- Election Day: Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
- Every registered voter in Los Angeles County receives a ballot by mail. Ballots can be returned by mail, at an official drop box, or at any vote center. Registration and vote center information: https://lavote.gov

## Jose Ugarte: documented record

- Jose Ugarte worked for Councilmember Curren Price from 2013 to 2019, left to run a lobbying business with his sister, Ugarte and Associates (registered in 2018), and returned to Price's office in 2021. (Sources: https://mynewsla.com/crime/2025/10/22/ethics-commission-to-fine-la-city-council-candidate/ ; https://laist.com/news/politics/voter-guides/2026-general-election-la-city-council-district-9)
- On Feb. 18, 2026, the L.A. City Ethics Commission ordered Jose Ugarte to pay a $25,000 fine (Case No. 2022-028). While working for the City Council, he failed to disclose his lobbying and consulting firm, Ugarte and Associates, and nearly half a million dollars in payments to it ($477,050.27 in gross income from clients paying $10,000 or more), on financial disclosure forms he signed under penalty of perjury. He admitted seven violations, including filing a required form 285 days late. In October 2025, the commission had rejected an earlier $17,500 settlement after two commissioners said it was not enough. (Sources: https://ethics.lacity.gov/pdf/agenda/2026/February/20260218-Item5-Stipulation-Ugarte.pdf ; https://laist.com/news/politics/voter-guides/2026-general-election-la-city-council-district-9)
- In the June 2026 primary, independent groups funded by Airbnb and the California Apartment Association spent more than $1 million supporting Ugarte. (Source: https://laist.com/news/politics/voter-guides/2026-general-election-la-city-council-district-9)
